svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-padfoot-roller","label_en":"Padfoot soil roller","label_is":"Tannvalti","section":"01","category_en":"Earthmoving and demolition machinery","category_is":"Jarðvinnslu- og niðurrifsvélar","batch":1,"tags":["compaction","roller"],"description":"A cab-and-wheel tractor pushes a steel drum with distinct raised rectangular compaction pads.","design_note":"Four sparse rectangular feet on the drum rim show padfoot contact without turning the machine into a sun symbol.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
